Summary: The ManuRAG multi-modal RAG manufacturing diagram figure caption text image retrieval pipeline includes four key stages: multimodal data extraction, indexing, retrieval, and answer generation. It employs a state-of-the-art PDF extraction pipeline integrating advanced vision and segmentation models for robust figure and content recognition. The framework uses a multi-modal embedding model to encode both text and images into the same embedding space, enabling cross-modal search capabilities. The pipeline also utilizes two separate vision language models (VLMs) at different stages: a lightweight VLM for indexing and a more powerful VLM for retrieving relevant image information at retrieval time.
